# QRCodeExtensions

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Fluent extension methods for QR codes.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Methods

- [`AltText`](#alttext): Sets the alternate text for accessibility (PDF/UA-1).
- [`BackgroundColor`](#backgroundcolor): Sets the background color of the QR code.
- [`DrawBackground`](#drawbackground): Toggles the drawing of the QR code background.
- [`ErrorCorrection`](#errorcorrection): Sets the error correction level for the QR code.
- [`ForegroundColor`](#foregroundcolor): Sets the foreground color of the QR code modules.
- [`QuietZone`](#quietzone): Sets the number of quiet zone modules around the QR code.
